scope: Wearable IMU behavior measurement, synchronized annotation, welfare governance, and relevant open hardware for indoor stall-fed goats and sheep.
limitations: This is a reproducible scoped evidence map, not a completed PRISMA systematic review or meta-analysis.
Scopus and Web of Science subscription searches were not available in the 2026-08-01 pass.
Transfer records cannot establish accuracy for the project's species, indoor setting, placement, device, or endpoint.

records.title: A pipeline with pre-processing options to detect behaviour from accelerometer data using Machine Learning tested on dairy goats
records.validation_split: Includes goats absent from training; exact experiment variants must be preserved when comparing metrics
records.result_summary: Tuned AUC values of 0.800-0.829 fell to 0.644-0.749 on goats absent from training.
limitations: Small cohort
Accelerometer only
Ear placement and study conditions may not transfer to neck or another enclosure
records.use_in_project: Closest direct methodological anchor for animal-held-out indoor-goat behavior modeling.

records.title: Data paper: A goat behaviour dataset combining labelled behaviours and accelerometer data for training Machine Learning detection models
records.setting: Eight indoor dairy Alpine goats, 24 h sensor capture and two annotated daylight periods
records.sensor_mount: Ear-tag triaxial accelerometer at 5 Hz with synchronized video
records.validation_split: Dataset description; downstream split must be performed by animal
records.result_summary: Documents the direct indoor-goat data provenance behind the ACT4Behav work.
limitations: Single trained observer
Small cohort
No gyroscope
records.use_in_project: Dataset provenance, annotation design comparison, and directness classification.

records.title: Accelerometers and annotated video recordings of behaviours: a dataset for training behaviour classification models in goats
records.setting: Indoor dairy-goat dataset corresponding to the Mauny data paper
records.validation_split: Not imposed by the dataset; project benchmarking must group by animal
records.result_summary: Public raw accelerometer and associated behavior data with repository file-level checksums.
limitations: Single observer
No gyroscope
Imported schema differs from Goat Sensor Lab
records.use_in_project: Reproducible external benchmark after explicit schema mapping and license recording.

records.title: Development of goat behaviour prediction with accelerometer data: a machine learning and pre-processing approach
records.sensor_mount: Neck-mounted LIS3DH triaxial accelerometer at 10 Hz
records.validation_split: Animal-independent evaluation discussed; preserve the paper's exact split when reproducing
records.result_summary: Shows indoor neck-accelerometer feasibility and warns that preprocessing and train/test choices can inflate metrics.
limitations: Different IMU and rate
Accelerometer only
Imported labels do not match this ethogram exactly
records.use_in_project: Direct neck-placement evidence and a leakage-control reference.

records.title: Review: Exploring the use of precision livestock farming for small ruminant welfare management
records.setting: Small-ruminant welfare across intensive and extensive systems
records.sample_size: Review and multi-country stakeholder workshops; not a sensor-validation cohort
records.result_summary: Maps many welfare concerns against limited technology readiness and supports risk-management alerts rather than diagnostic claims.
limitations: Synthesis rather than validation of this device
Heterogeneous systems and technologies
records.use_in_project: Primary welfare-claim framing and readiness boundary.

records.title: Non-invasive monitoring for precision sheep farming: Development, challenges, and future perspectives
records.setting: Precision sheep farming across production environments
records.sensor_mount: Wearable, adhesive, weighing, and visual monitoring technologies
records.result_summary: Current synthesis of non-invasive sheep monitoring technologies and adoption challenges.
limitations: Review rather than direct validation
Sheep-only and heterogeneous settings
records.use_in_project: Current sheep technology landscape and gap identification.

records.title: Application of a Lightweight, Open-Hardware Wearable System for Robust Behaviour Monitoring in Precision Livestock Farming
records.setting: Pasture-based dairy-goat field proof of concept
records.sensor_mount: Approximately 60 g collar with 6-axis IMU, GPS, ESP32 and ESP-NOW at 20 Hz
records.sample_size: See paper table; hardware proof of concept rather than a definitive ethology study
records.validation_split: Window-level and animal-level evaluations are both reported
records.result_summary: Window-level F1 above 0.99 fell to animal-held-out macro-F1 0.31, demonstrating placement/domain-shift risk.
limitations: Pasture and GPS domain
Different collar, radio, enclosure, and behaviors
Authors frame animal work as hardware proof of concept
records.use_in_project: Transfer-only open-hardware reference and strong warning against window-level leakage.

records.title: A Two-Stage Farmer Assistant for Kidding Detection: Enhancing Farming Productivity and Animal Welfare
records.setting: 28 Charnequeira goats across 2024-2025 kidding seasons; pasture by day and controlled overnight housing near parturition
records.sensor_mount: Collar triaxial accelerometer and temperature at 20 Hz with collar/edge inference
records.validation_split: Use only the exact paper split when interpreting the reported MCC
records.result_summary: Reports a two-stage embedded/edge architecture and MCC 0.91 for its kidding endpoint.
limitations: Reproductive endpoint outside the core behavior pilot
Mixed pasture/overnight context
No transfer to disease, pregnancy confirmation, or unattended management
records.use_in_project: Transfer-only architecture and future registered reproduction-study reference.

records.title: BORIS: a free, versatile open-source event-logging software for video/audio coding and live observations
records.setting: Video/audio coding and live-observation software; official site listed release 9.13.0 on 2026-07-21
records.result_summary: Provides an auditable open-source annotation tool option; it does not create scientific agreement by itself.
limitations: Tool choice does not replace rater training, blinding, agreement, immutable exports, or consensus provenance
records.use_in_project: Reference workflow for independent media annotation and event export.

records.title: ARRIVE guidelines 2.0
authors: NC3Rs and the ARRIVE working group
records.result_summary: Defines essential reporting for design, sample-size rationale, exclusions, randomization, blinding, outcomes, animals, procedures, and results.
limitations: Reporting guidance does not replace ethics approval or a study-specific statistical design

records.title: PREPARE guidelines
records.result_summary: Provides a planning checklist spanning formulation, facility preparation, training, husbandry, procedures, and humane endpoints.
limitations: Planning guidance does not replace local legal or institutional requirements
